name: PCEval — Physical Circuit
protocol: PCEval v1 fixed 50-project D,C-to-P track, five trials per project, baseline standardized prompt, Wokwi functional tests plus physical implementability checks. Self-improvement and CoT interventions are excluded.

explanation.en: The score averages 250 binary trials; a layout passes only when the Wokwi scenario succeeds and physical pin/connectivity constraints are satisfied.
explanation.zh: 分数是 250 次二元试验的平均值；布局必须通过 Wokwi scenario，并满足物理引脚与连接约束才算成功。

summary.en: PCEval tests whether models can turn an Arduino project description and program into a functional, physically buildable breadboard layout.
summary.zh: PCEval 测试模型能否把 Arduino 项目描述和程序转换成功能正确、实际可搭建的面包板电路布局。

task_format.en: Given a project description and reference Arduino code, the model generates a structured physical breadboard circuit for Wokwi execution.
task_format.zh: 模型根据项目描述和参考 Arduino code，生成用于 Wokwi 执行的结构化物理面包板电路。
